name: Kurask

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows superior Slayer monsters, including King kurasks, to spawn while on task.

requiredItemName: leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart

variantInfo.name: Kurask
notes: Normal and big 3D models are cosmetic only and have the same stats.
Can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.

variantInfo.name: King kurask
notes: Has a chance of spawning on a kurask's death while on task after purchasing the Bigger and Badder unlock for 50 Slayer reward points.
Has no special mechanics but is significantly more accurate and has a max hit of 33.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
notes: 5 kurasks are in the main dungeon, while 9 more are in a task-only section overseen by Jelly.
Very large area compared to other dungeons.
Cannons and thralls do not damage Kurasks.

locationComparison.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
notes: Kurasks here have a chance of dropping crystal shards on death.
This crystal shard drop is guaranteed from King kurasks.
A cannon can be set up here, but Kurasks are immune to cannon damage.

locationComparison.name: Kurask Lair
notes: Kurasks are clumped tighter in this dungeon.
Requires 58 Sailing to dock on Laguna Aurorae for the first time.
Docking is not required once the spirit tree on the island has been spoken to, and the spirit tree is significantly closer to the lair than the docking point.
A cannon can be set up here, but Kurasks are immune to cannon damage.

taskNotes: Kurasks can be assigned as a Slayer task by medium and high level Slayer masters upon reaching 70 Slayer and 65 combat.
Kurasks are found in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, Iorwerth Dungeon after completing Song of the Elves, and Kurask Lair on Laguna Aurorae with 58 Sailing.
In the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, there is also a separate task-only area.
Kurasks have two 3D models, normal and big, but this is merely cosmetic because there is no stat difference.
Kurasks attack with somewhat inaccurate crush attacks that can hit up to 11.
Protect from Melee will negate all Kurask damage.
Players with at least 75 Defence can avoid praying and instead collect bones and occasionally cast Bones to Peaches to restore health at a lower supply cost.
The Bones to Peaches method requires more attention and is unlocked from the Mage Training Arena.
King kurask is the superior version unlocked with Bigger and Badder.
King kurask has no special mechanics, but is significantly more accurate and has a max hit of 33.
When using Bones to Peaches, turn on Protect from Melee and use at least one Prayer potion if a King kurask spawns.
Kurasks are weakest to stab, ranged, and magic attacks.
Kurasks have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Cannons and Thralls will not deal any damage to Kurasks.
Special attacks from Saradomin godsword, Ancient godsword, and Toxic blowpipe can still heal the player as if the attack rolled damage.
Special attacks from Ancient mace and Eldritch nightmare staff can restore prayer points based on rolled damage.
Guthan's equipment set effect will not activate against Kurasks.
Kurasks frequently drop High Alchemy weapons and armour with Nature runes.
Players should bring an Herb sack because Kurasks always drop three herbs when they roll the herb drop table.
Kurasks also drop seeds, coins, noted white berries, noted big bones, coconuts, and papaya fruit.
Kurasks in the Iorwerth Dungeon additionally drop Crystal shards, and King Kurasks there always drop Crystal shards.
Kurasks have a small aggressive range of 2 centered on their south-west tile.
recommendedMethod: Use leaf-bladed battleaxe melee, broad ammunition ranged, or Magic Dart only. Protect from Melee is simplest; 75 Defence accounts can use Bones to Peaches for cheaper longer trips, but should pray if King kurask spawns.
